fullDescription: A sophisticated digital archive and editorial style guide inspired by museum curation and neoclassical aesthetics. Featuring a 'Colobus Curio' theme, it utilizes a rich palette of deep hunter green, charcoal, and metallic gold accents against a warm cream foundation. Key visual identifiers include subtle noise overlays for a tactile paper feel, 'plaque-style' bordered artifact cards, and floating animations for background elements. This design system is ideal for luxury e-commerce, digital museums, high-end portfolios, educational archives, or fintech platforms seeking a prestigious, heritage-driven identity. Layouts leverage high-contrast typography pairings of elegant serifs and clean tracking, balanced with 'bento-grid' inspired artifact displays and immersive dark-mode exhibition sections.

structured.summary: A refined, academic-meets-modern digital archive system. It uses a 'museum-curated' aesthetic with paper textures, gold ornamentation, and editorial typography. The interface prioritizes historical weight and technological precision through a mix of serif headings and bold, uppercase sans-serif labels.

style.description: The style is defined by its 'Heritage Digital' theme. Typography relies heavily on 'Playfair Display' for an editorial feel, using weights 400-900 and frequent use of italics for emphasis. The color palette is strictly anchored in Cream (#fefdef), Hunter Green (#00604a), Crimson (#bd264a), and Gold (#d4af37). Animation is used to simulate physical weight and discovery, featuring floating artifacts, staggered reveals, and smooth color transitions. A persistent noise overlay provides a grainy, organic texture.
style.prompt:
Create a design with a 'Digital Museum' aesthetic. 
- **Color Palette**: Background: #fefdef (Cream); Primary: #00604a (Green); Accents: #bd264a (Red) and #d4af37 (Gold); Text: #2c2c2c (Charcoal).
- **Typography**: Headers in 'Playfair Display' (serif). Use large sizes (7xl-9xl) for hero sections with specific words italicized. UI labels and navigation links in all-caps, tracking-wide (0.2em) sans-serif, font-size 10px-12px.
- **Visual Texture**: Apply a global fixed noise overlay (SVG fractal noise at 0.08 opacity). 
- **UI Accents**: Use 'Plaque Corners' (16px x 16px L-shaped borders in #d4af37) on cards. Ornamental dividers using a 1px line (#d4af37/40) interrupted by a central icon (e.g., 'gem' or 'diamond').
- **Animations**: Implement a 'floating' keyframe (translateY: 0 to -20px over 6s) for background icons. Hover states for cards should involve a shift from grayscale to color and a subtle scale up (1.1x).

layout_and_structure.description: A structured, section-based layout that transitions from a wide-open hero section to dense artifact grids, followed by high-contrast immersive full-width blocks.

prompts.prompt: A fixed top bar (#fefdef) with a 1px bottom border (#00604a/10). Left: Logo consisting of a square green box with a serif 'C'. Center: Text links (Cabinet, Collections, About) in 12px uppercase. Right: A 'Discovery/Exhibition' toggle switch and a primary 'Sign In' button (bg-#00604a, rounded-sm, tracking-widest).

A centered layout with a layered background. Background includes low-opacity (10-40%) grayscale artifact drawings (blueprints, dragons, statues) with a floating animation. Foreground text features a 72pt+ serif title with one word in italicized Red (#bd264a). Include two primary CTA buttons: one solid Green with a slide-up hover effect, one outlined in Red.

A multi-column grid (4 columns on desktop). Each card is an 'Artifact Card' with a muted beige background (#eeedd9) and 'plaque corners' (#d4af37). Images inside cards are centered, grayscale by default, and transition to color on hover. Below the image: a category label with a gold dot bullet, a 2xl serif title, and a small-text charcoal description.

A full-width high-contrast section with a dark green background (#002f24). Features a large circular orbital graphic on one side with a 30s linear spin animation. Typography remains white/gold. This section acts as a 'break' in the cream-colored flow.

A focused section with a centered search input. The input has no box, only a 2px bottom border (#00604a). Placeholder text is light charcoal in 2xl Playfair Display. A search icon sits at the right edge of the underline.

A four-column layout on a #eeedd9 background. Includes a logo/description column, a social links column, and two columns for navigation. Bottom row contains a copyright notice and 'Hosted' metadata in 10px uppercase, tracking-wide text.

special_ui_components.description: A sophisticated card container that mimics a museum display plaque.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a container with aspect-ratio 4:5, background color #eeedd9. Add four absolute-positioned corner elements (1.5px border-color: #d4af37). Inside, center a high-resolution artifact image. Apply a transition: group-hover:shadow-[0_40px_80px_-15px_rgba(0,96,74,0.3)] and group-hover:scale-110 for the image.

special_ui_components.description: A delicate separator used to break long vertical scroll sections.
special_ui_components.prompt: A horizontal line spanning 100% width with 1px height and color #d4af37 at 40% opacity. In the exact center, place a 48px padding-x background-color: #fefdef containing a 'gem' icon flanked by two 12px horizontal sub-lines.
